fact: The Council of Ministers of 22 April 2026 adopted a draft ordonnance on the civil status regime of Niger, amending Loi n° 2019-29 of 1 July 2019 to clarify the national civil status register and the national population register and to add biometric parameters and a unique identifier; it is a draft adopted by cabinet, with no promulgation stated.
system: Projet d'ordonnance portant régime de l'état civil au Niger (amending Loi n° 2019-29 of 2019)
